changes.title: Tab options: close the known gaps, add a dock setting
changes.detail:
Batch 31. The leftovers from the first tab pass, each fixed and then seen in a local build. The menu key used to open two menus at once, which is one more than anybody asked for.

- "Close other tabs" preview lists every tab that stays, with its reason. - The group picker no longer closes the all-tabs search it was opened from. - Move to start/end for a grouped tab stays inside its group. - Menu key and Shift+F10 open exactly one menu; Escape returns focus. - Search and name fields in tab panels take focus on open. - The selected tab scrolls fully into view. - Automation editor save bar sits at the page bottom with a bottom strip. - New "Tab strip position" row in Profile.

Still not built, recorded in the changelog: settings pages and tools as tabs of their own; groups, looks and locks for settings section tabs and the phone Pages sheet.

Checks: type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors; full suite 6,896 passed with the 3 known build-script failures.
changes.detail_yue: 第 31 批。分頁功能第一輪留低嘅手尾，逐樣修好再喺本機 build 睇過。選單鍵 以前一撳出兩個選單，多咗一個冇人要嘅。仲未做嘅照直寫喺更新紀錄：設定頁 同工具未可以自己開成分頁；設定分頁同手機頁面表未有分組、外觀同鎖。
